system.monsterType: Human (Rare). Mystics are humans who rigorously follow a way of life involving a special discipline of meditation, study, and physical training. They live in special building complexes (called "cloisters" or "monasteries") located far from towns and common civilization. NPCs mystics are possible, otherwise, mystics will be encountered on a pilgrimage, mission, or adventure for their cloister. Mystics are usually (75%) Lawful, although other alignments are represented. All are utterly devoted to mystic discipline. All their material goods are owned by the cloister, and loaned to individual mystics as needed.
